constraints: Domain management privilege or approved security authority.

permissions.description: Register, configure or suspend connector installations.
constraints: Changes use protected credentials and explicit authority policy.

permissions.description: Start or review a connector synchronization run.
constraints: Approved scope and profile required. Reject unapproved destructive absence.

permissions.description: Process verified inbound input and apply connector pages.
constraints: Connection version, direction, field authority, and service worker scope checked.

permissions.description: Claim, heartbeat or finish registered job classes.
constraints: Worker pool, active lease and exact fence required.

permissions.description: Inspect and repair eligible blocked background work.
constraints: No arbitrary replay of unknown external effects.

permissions.description: Set one's optional channel preferences.
constraints: Self scope. Required in-app academic receipts cannot be disabled.

permissions.description: Record delivery, failure or confirmed retry of an approved notification.
constraints: Recheck audience, purpose and the current delivery route.

permissions.description: Record a backup restoration exercise and verified milestones.
constraints: Independent reviewer required before reopening.

permissions.description: Publish exact institutional safety policy versions.
constraints: Require independent review and prevent silent deadline changes.

scenarios.title: Institution isolation holds with a valid known resource ID
given: Principal P has directory capability in institution A
Known learner B1 belongs to institution B
when: P searches B's directory and then directly requests a scoped audit view about B1
then: Both deny or return authorized non-disclosing absence. No B1 name, count or existence leaks.

scenarios.title: Two related children share a verified family inbox
given: Two siblings have separate educational identities and use one family email
when: Both contacts are verified under independently authorized sessions
then: Contacts remain separate. No account linking, role transfer or educational merge occurs.

scenarios.title: Provider subject collision does not merge accounts
given: Two active Principals claim the same verified provider issuer and subject for one connection
when: A and B concurrently consume valid link proofs
then: At most one binding commits. The loser receives SUBJECT_ALREADY_BOUND and no session for the winning Principal.

scenarios.title: Role scope is recomputed after a hierarchy move
given: Manager M holds a descendants grant in unit West. Course X belongs to unit P, a child of West.
when: Registrar moves P under East with approved current impact preview while M holds an active session
then: Authorization epoch increments. M cannot access X on the next request. Old audit evidence still references West.

scenarios.title: Non-overlapping grants are accepted at the exact boundary
given: Assistant A has an approved scoped grant ending 2027-06-01T12:00:00Z
when: Approve a new matching role grant starting at the same instant
then: There is no overlap under half-open semantics. A request at that instant selects only the new grant.

scenarios.title: Restriction overrides institutional authority
given: Admin A has explicit institution view and a temporary incident grant. An active restriction covers one sensitive learner.
when: A uses the emergency grant to request that learner's protected attachment
then: Deny wins. Audit records a restricted decision and no storage ticket is issued.

scenarios.title: Guardian right ends while a notice is queued
given: Verified guardian G may view released reports for learner L and an optional report notice is queued
when: Revoke relationship before dispatch, then process the notification job
then: Send is suppressed and a former guardian session cannot fetch the report. Existing audit survives.

scenarios.title: Closing a term preserves existing report snapshots
given: An open term has issued reports pinned to period version 2
when: Registrar closes the term and subsequently reopens with independent approval
then: New association follows state. Old reports retain their original schedule and context.

scenarios.title: Concurrent hold prevents destruction
given: Submission S is past retention and a disposal job is queued
when: A valid hold commits before the worker obtains the target lock
then: Worker reports LEGAL_HOLD_ACTIVE or blocked. Binary and authoritative record remain.

scenarios.title: Processor timeout leaves privacy request incomplete
given: Local data is deleted and protected external file outcome is uncertain
when: Worker records blocked outcome and reviewer attempts to complete the case
then: Completion denied. No repeat destructive call without evidence. Local completed action key is preserved.

scenarios.title: Rejected binary never becomes readable
given: Author uploads a file claimed as a PDF to a known allowed resource
when: Backend digest verifies but content inspection finds active unsafe executable content
then: Record unsafe verdict, quarantine and deny all delivery tickets, including for the uploader.

scenarios.title: Ticket cannot be redeemed after access revocation
given: Teacher holds valid five-minute download ticket for assessment attachment
when: Teaching grant is revoked one minute after issuance. Teacher retries after two minutes.
then: Gateway checks current epoch and owner permission. No response bytes are released.

scenarios.title: Incomplete roster response never withdraws absent learners
given: Two learners exist in the current class and an inbound full snapshot times out after page one
when: Finalize with failure and no provider completion marker
then: Keep both enrollments and record the last safe checkpoint. No absence removal appears.

scenarios.title: Explicit null does not clear a forbidden profile field
given: Profile email rule denies clearing and synchronization adapter receives authenticated explicit null
when: Apply a page with the null field and a second row where the key is absent
then: Explicit null produces a rejected field issue. Absence is no-op. No silent email change.

scenarios.title: Callback duplicates are distinguished from payload substitution
given: Connector sends a verified message ID and digest A
when: Repeat message with identical bytes, then send same ID with a different validly signed digest B
then: Identical replay returns first receipt. Digest B is rejected and investigated. Apply at most once.

scenarios.title: Expired worker fence cannot commit
given: Worker A claims a job under fence 17, then stalls past 120 seconds
when: Reaper expires fence 17. B claims the job under fence 18 and commits. A wakes and submits completion.
then: B's effect persists once. A receives LEASE_FENCED and cannot close B's claim.

scenarios.title: Provider acknowledgement loss does not duplicate email
given: Mail provider may have accepted a notice before timeout and offers no idempotent resend
when: Record uncertain and attempt automatic repair without a provider lookup
then: Job blocks. No second send occurs until absence is verified or service configuration supports stable keys.

scenarios.title: Restore reapplies withdrawal, erasure and queued effects before reopening
given: Backup is from 10:00 and later records include a role revocation, protected deletion and accepted provider notice
when: Restore to 10:00, replay durable journals in isolation, verify references and compare service objectives
then: Withdrawn access remains denied, deleted bytes are not served, and provider notice is not repeated.

scenarios.title: Locale preference does not reinterpret exam deadline
given: Student's exam deadline is already resolved to a server instant and preferred timezone is UTC
when: Student changes presentation timezone and browser locale while exam is in progress
then: Shown local time changes. The server acceptance instant and due-at snapshot are identical.

scenarios.title: Same idempotency key with different intent returns a conflict
given: A valid role assignment command with key k1 commits for learner class C1
when: Repeat exact body and key, then use k1 with a different bounded interval
then: Identical replay returns original receipt. Changed normalized body receives IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

scenarios.title: Credential rotation prevents stale connector writes
given: Old run was pinned to enabled connector version 4 and is about to mutate provider membership
when: Suspend connector and rotate credential reference under reviewed version 6 before old dispatch
then: Old run fails configuration check. Reconciliation begins only with newly enabled version.

scenarios.title: Expired proof cannot become valid after relinking another account
given: Human Principal requests account link with nonce N and configured browser session A
when: Attempt completion with browser session B and then with session A after 15 minutes
then: Both fail without binding the subject. A fresh recent-authentication flow is required.

scenarios.title: Service mandate cannot claim a job outside its approved queue
given: A scan worker is scoped to institution I and asset_scan
when: The worker requests exam_marking and separately attempts a claim in institution J
then: Both denied without changing any job fence. Its valid scan claim remains possible.

scenarios.title: A dispatched effect with no acknowledgement remains uncertain
given: A connector commits dispatch intent and sends an authorized room membership removal
when: Worker dies after provider applies removal and before receiving acknowledgement
then: Reconciliation detects provider membership already absent and confirms same stable effect. A second provider mutation is unnecessary.

scenarios.title: Backup base cannot be retired while a verified descendant depends on it
given: Base backup S is past rotation threshold and dependent set D is newest verified restore path
when: Operator requests retirement of S
then: Retirement denied under coverage lock. D remains eligible. Record the dependency without leaking backup credentials.

scenarios.title: Failed pages cannot advance the committed cursor
given: A provider page at cursor c17 contains 12 valid rows and a last row that violates authority
when: The adapter cannot durably stage the invalid row due to transaction failure
then: No receipt commits and cursor remains c17. Retrying the same bytes applies at most one effect per row.

scenarios.title: Provisioned school closure preserves controlled academic custody
given: An independently approved deployment adds school WEST and fixes the default locale and zone. Registrar has custody approval.
when: Provision WEST, publish a reviewed 15-minute idle timeout policy, suspend WEST, deny normal sign-in, then request closure with registrar approval.
then: Exactly one institution root and independent policy chain exist. Closure leaves 3 issued records available only through the retained records workflow. A second institution stays active.

scenarios.title: Unit archival and term creation honor distinct structures
given: School S is active. Department Maths is an active child with two active offerings. Calendar year 2027 exists.
when: Attempt to archive S, archive Maths before transfer, create an overflowing child term, then create the in-range term and archive Maths after its two responsibilities transfer.
then: First two archives fail due to dependencies. The overflowing period is rejected. The contained period exists as draft. Final archive retains Maths history and both transferred offerings.

scenarios.title: Person onboarding and compromise follow separate lifecycles
given: A registrar receives verified learner number NEW-710. No account or grade history exists yet.
when: Create Person and two authorized human Principals, link permitted independent providers, and record an enrollment. Suspend Principal A for compromise, unlink its provider binding, and later mark Person inactive.
then: A cannot sign in after suspension, B retains eligible access until Person becomes inactive, and both subsequently lose protected access. Enrollment is still attributable to the original Person.

scenarios.title: Replacing a shared household email requires new proof
given: Learner L has verified email contact A and receives opted-in learning reminders at A. One reminder is queued.
when: Begin verification for replacement B, try to use A's old proof, verify B with its new proof, revoke A, then disable optional email before the queued reminder sends.
then: Old proof cannot verify B. B is independently verified, A is revoked, and no reminder is sent because current preference is disabled. Required in-app exam receipts remain available.

scenarios.title: Role definition review never widens existing scoped assignments
given: Existing assistant assignments use assistant-custom revision 1 with two capabilities. Security reviewer approves revision 2 with a third capability.
when: Publish revision 2, request revision 2 in sibling section beyond delegated scope, then request it within scope and have reviewer reject based on missing training evidence.
then: Existing assignments retain exactly two capabilities. Out-of-scope proposal creates no grant. In-scope proposal is denied by reviewer without activating the third capability.

scenarios.title: Guardian disclosure is granted only for approved release categories
given: Learner L has one released report and one unreleased assessment. Verified guardian evidence is submitted.
when: Request relationship, try to read while requested, independently approve progress_summary only, read progress and request released_report, then revoke the relationship.
then: No pending disclosure occurs. Exactly the approved progress view is available until revocation. Report and unreleased work are never exposed.

scenarios.title: Emergency approval and restriction lifting follow independent decisions
given: Incident IR-401 affects provider installation C. Worker operator O requests read-only connector diagnostics. A separate active containment restriction covers outbound writes.
when: O requests emergency access, attempts to approve own request, reviewer R approves diagnostics for 30 minutes, O reads, reviewer revokes grant, and a second reviewer approves lifting containment.
then: Self-approval denied. Exactly one diagnostic read succeeds and is audited. No outbound write is granted by the emergency grant or restriction lift.

scenarios.title: A held privacy case resumes only its pending approved step
given: Learner L requests approved scope for two old drafts. Existing 90-day rules protect the drafts. One draft remains held.
when: Publish a new 60-day rule, submit and verify request at age 95 days, independently approve two tasks, complete one, encounter hold on the other, release hold, and resume then complete. Auditor requests scoped metadata.
then: Prior 90-day minimum was honored. Exactly two disposal effects occur once each. Audit returns approved action metadata and no draft content.

scenarios.title: Security revocation interrupts future reads of a vulnerable file
given: A clean published PDF has an active access ticket when a scanner rules update detects unsafe content.
when: An authorized security officer revokes the binary and two readers request another ticket or redeem an old one.
then: Both later access paths fail. The previous published resource shows degraded file dependency. The file bytes and scan evidence remain quarantined until approved disposal.

scenarios.title: Connector activation, cancel and reviewed removal keep exact roster versions
given: An institution wants to onboard a roster adapter with profile roster-v1 and two active learners.
when: Register disabled, approve enable, run and cancel a dry run, then stage one absence in a verified complete snapshot. A reviewer tries to approve with stale local enrollment version, refreshes and approves exact current diff.
then: Disabled connection sends nothing. Canceled dry run does not advance persistent cursor. Stale approval mutates nothing. Reviewed current decision invokes one canonical removal and records the applied version.

scenarios.title: External map conflict cannot silently resurrect a removed account
given: A local person is mapped to provider P-77 at desired version 12 and has an active collaboration membership.
when: Publish explicit local removal at version 13. Receive a stale inbound identity update and record rejection. Reconciliation reviewer attempts to match a new P-77 by email then verifies the provider's original opaque identity.
then: Desired removal remains at 13. Stale inbound does not reopen membership. Email-only resolution fails. Approved exact map reconciliation retains history and confirms removal.

scenarios.title: Heartbeat and cancellation never close a different worker's lease
given: A job is leased at fence 30 with 120-second deadline. The first provider call fails before it is sent.
when: Heartbeat at 30 seconds, record transient failure with safe retry, cancel while waiting, then retry stale heartbeat and attempt to claim.
then: Heartbeat had extended the live lease. Failure scheduled one retry at the specified bound. Cancellation prevents any new claim and stale heartbeat receives LEASE_FENCED.

scenarios.title: Recovery starts only from signed verified coverage
given: Backup object horizon covers 10:04:00, database horizon covers 10:03:30 and manifest is signed. Incident started at 10:05:00.
when: Capture and verify the set, plan restore at 10:03:30, record start and verification, then try to pass before independent approval and again after approved evidence.
then: Unverified pass is rejected. Verified exercise reports RPO 90 seconds and RTO 7500 seconds, with protected result manifest retained.

scenarios.title: Changed remote payload cannot reuse an existing provider effect key
given: An authorized room removal operation is prepared under a stable effect key and digest A.
when: Retry identical preparation, then attempt preparation under same key with digest B and different recipient. Dispatch approved digest A once and record verified outcome.
then: First replay resolves same prepared intent. Recipient substitution rejected before dispatch. Exactly one matching effect confirmed.

scenarios.title: Corrected labels and calendar metadata preserve released snapshots
given: A published assessment and issued report pin learner name L1 and period version 4. A registrar finds an approved learner name correction and a term boundary error.
when: Attempt date correction without review, then submit authorized reviewed change and correct the current display name with evidence.
then: Unreviewed dates fail. Authorized current period and name versions advance. Published assessment deadlines and old report label remain at their historical values until formal owner correction.

scenarios.title: One data access case excludes another learner's records
given: Authorized learner requests own academic export. A teacher file contains own evidence and another learner's data.
when: Apply approved exact projection and record independent excluded field evidence before completion.
then: Only own allowed fields reach the private artifact. No source content is deleted or mutated. Request is complete after all approved projections and exclusions are recorded.
